opening.argument: The video presents a Bitcoin trading-pool opportunity built around compounding returns: participants are told that “The more money you got in the trading pool, the more you're going to make,” while a $500 projection reaches “over $361,749.95” after 60 months. It then solicits participation by directing viewers to “click the link below. Get on my team” and to join an associated Facebook group. Although the speaker acknowledges that participants can lose some or all of their Bitcoin and that earning Bitcoin is not guaranteed, those qualifications do not remove the promotional presentation of pool-based returns or the direct invitation to participate.
